title: Running late, and your trip without a connection
points: Running late? Tell the hostel office you'll be back 15, 30 or 60 minutes later, once per outing, with a reason if you like. Your late alert moves to the new time.

The people you share your location with see when you're due back, and hear when you're back, running late or 30 minutes late. If a share with them times out while you're out, they're told it timed out, nothing more. Stopping a share yourself tells nobody.
Today shows your current trip and the hostel office's number even when you have no connection.
The hostel office can see Late today and the hostel's details in the app, as on the website.
Opening the app or the gate scanner wakes the server sooner, so there's less waiting.

title: Help while you're out, and a new starting screen
points: While you're out, Help tells the hostel office where you are (one location, once) and lets your followers and emergency contact know you asked for help. The hostel office's number is there to call.
The hostel office can send a notice to everyone who is out and note each call they make about a late student. Alerts that can't reach a phone are emailed instead.
If an admin changes your email address, you choose a new password from a link sent to the new address.
A new starting screen: it tells you when the server has started, signs you in and welcomes you back.

title: A student's whole history, and an audit log
points: The hostel office can open a student's history from People, the register or the Out list: who they are, their outings with any corrections and late follow-ups, their requests and their gate scans. Wardens see only their own hostels' students.
Admins have an audit log of what the office changed, with a search and dates.
Scans can be searched by name or roll number and narrowed to dates, and the register and Late today can be narrowed to one hostel.
The CSV export opens cleanly in Excel, with clear column names and times in Indian time.
The Gates page shows whether each gate's tablet is still checking in, and admins can set quiet hours when the gate tablets rest (off unless set).
While the server wakes up after a quiet spell, the app and the website show a Lumiback waiting screen instead of a blank page.

title: Act on several people at once, and lists that remember
points: On the website's People list, the hostel office can tick several people and move them to another hostel, send the set-up link again, or turn their accounts off in one go. It then says what happened for each person.
The register, People, scans and escalations open on the filter you chose last time, on the website and in the app. Signing out forgets them.
Developers have a Status page showing which version of the website, app and server is running, and whether the database is up to date.

title: A guided tour on the website too
points: The website has the same guided tour as the app: it points out each part the first time you sign in there, and after updates that change something. Take it again any time from Account.
On the app, the hostel office's bar at the bottom is now compact, with both of its names showing.

title: A new look, and a guided tour
points: Lumiback has a new look on the app and the website: a dark board with a dot-matrix countdown, like the boards at a station.
While you're out, Today shows your trip as a line from when you left to your back-by time, with a dot for now, and the time left as 1:32 h or 32 min.
Scan has its own button next to the bar, so it's always one tap away.
History lists each outing on one line, with its times on the left.
A short guided tour points out each part of the app the first time you sign in, and after updates that change something. Take it again any time from Profile, then Help.

title: Safer sign-outs and account controls
points: Signing a device out, changing your password or turning an account off now works every time, even if that device was signing in at the same moment.
A device you sign out stops seeing live locations and getting notifications straight away.
When the hostel office changes an account's email or turns an account off, any set-password link or reset code already sent stops working.
Wardens see only students in the student list, and a refused gate tap-out no longer closes an outing still open from an earlier day.
Gate and register pages load faster.

title: Your devices and your password
points: Profile shows every phone and browser signed in to your account. Lost your phone? Sign it out from another device, and it stops working at once.
Change your password from Profile. Every other device is signed out, and this one stays signed in.
Hostel office admins can remove a gate that was added by mistake. A gate students have used stays, and can be switched off instead.

title: Office account controls
points: The hostel office can turn an account off and on again. Turning it off signs that person out everywhere and keeps their history.
The hostel office can correct a student's name, roll no. or phone, and admins can fix an email address, cancel an invite nobody used, or add one person at a time.
Emails about your account and your return now show a clear button, and reminders give the exact time you were due back.

title: Fix an outing that went wrong
points: Forgot to tap in, or tapped by mistake? Ask the hostel office to fix it from History. Nothing changes until they approve.
If an outing from an earlier day is still open, the gate asks whether you're coming in or going out, instead of guessing.
The hostel office can record a return or fix a return time, and every change keeps the original time.

title: Another outing, and accounts the office sets up
points: After using today's approved outing, you can ask the hostel office for another. It still needs their approval.
Hostel office admins can add students in bulk on the website. Each student gets an email to choose their password, and admins can send a student a link to choose a new password.

title: Safer links
points: Links far too long to be a real Lumiback link open the home screen instead, so a crafted link can't freeze the app.

title: Safer taps
points: Taps are refused while another app draws over Lumiback, so a hidden screen on top can't steer you into tapping in or out with a gate code from a link. If a chat bubble or screen filter is in the way, Lumiback tells you; close it and tap again.
Send my location asks to turn location on, and offers the settings that fix it.

title: Safe return and your data
points: Add your emergency contact's email, and when you head out you can tick "Let them follow until I'm back". They get a link to your live location that stops when you're back, a note if you're 30 minutes late, and one when you're back safely.
Profile has Download my data: a file with your profile, outings, requests, shares and gate scans.
The hostel office shows an error with Try again when it can't load, instead of zero counts. Staff can see the gate scans log, and head wardens and admins can add and remove holidays.
New passwords are checked against known data breaches, and push notifications are retried and checked for delivery.

Safer sharing: a gate code opened from a link asks before tapping you in or out, removing your emergency contact from a share stops their emails too, and a browser only sends your location after you tap Share location from this browser.
Signing out stops sending your location and ends a share you started in the app; safe return keeps running so your contact still hears if you're late. Updates now show how far the download has got.

title: Hostel moves and late follow-up
points: You choose your hostel once. If you move, the hostel office changes it for you.
Wardens, head wardens and admins can move a student to another of their hostels from Students. Earlier outings stay with the hostel they were taken from.
Answering "On my way" or "I'm safe" holds off the hostel office for an hour. If you're still not back after that, they're told so they can check on you.

title: Steadier updates and sign-in
points: Updating the app no longer looks stuck at 100%: it says it's checking the download, then opens Android's installer. If the installer can't open, tap Install to try again; the download is kept.
Opening the app with no signal no longer signs you out, and a moment without signal no longer ends live sharing.
The hostel office lists show the section or hostel you picked, even when you switch quickly.

title: Smaller downloads
points: New versions of the app download about 55 MB instead of 120 MB: Lumiback picks the file made for your phone.
On the website, Get the app offers the version for modern phones, with the others under Other versions.

title: Updates itself
points: When a new version of the app is out, Lumiback downloads it for you and opens Android's installer: tap Install and you're done. You stay signed in.
The first time, Android asks you to allow Lumiback to install apps. That permission is only used for Lumiback's own updates.
A download that doesn't arrive complete is thrown away and never installed.

title: The hostel office in the app
points: Wardens, head wardens and admins open straight into the Hostel office on Today: outing requests, late students who aren't answering, and who's out. Tap-out, sharing and history stay with students.
Approve or decline outing requests, call a student or their family, and mark escalations as handled, right from your phone.

Students, rules and gates in the office too: each hostel's students with their contacts, the outing hours each hostel follows, and the gates taking scans. Admins can add a gate standing at it and make a new kiosk link.
New roles: a warden sees only their own hostels' students; a head warden sees every hostel and sets the outing rules. Admins also change roles from the app.
Notifications about new requests and escalations open the right screen.

title: Clearer outings and support
points: Email Lumiback support from Help (Profile in the app, Account on the website). You get a reply in your inbox.
On days that need approval, ask for your outing in the morning, before outings open, so it's approved in time. You can also cancel an approved request you haven't used.
Asking for a shorter outing: pick any whole number of hours below your limit. Once approved, you see when you'll be due back.
Today says when your approval is used, when outing rules aren't set up, when it can't load, and asks you to choose your hostel if you haven't.
Return reminders no longer suggest adding time, and a late tap-in at the gate says so.
The website's Share page shows who looked at your location, like the app.
Help explains when you can go out and how long your data is kept.

title: Outing rules
points: Your hostel sets your outing hours: weekday and Saturday evenings 6–8 PM, and Sunday or holiday outings with the hostel office's approval.
Boys' hostels can go out 6–8 PM on Sundays and holidays without a form.
Return times can't be extended. If you're late, the app checks you're OK.
Updates now ask first: Update now, or Remind me later.
A clear version number, and this list of what's new.

title: Polish and safety
points: Reset a forgotten password with an email code.
A faked GPS location shows in red beside your last real one.
A fuller Today screen and easier-to-read colours.

title: Gate tap-in and tap-out
points: Scan the QR code at the gate to go out and come back.
Notifications for follow requests and return reminders, even when the app is closed.
A new look, and updates without reinstalling.

title: First release
points: Log your outings and see your history.
Share your live location with people you choose, and follow theirs.
